description:
Game logic without code: turns a built scene into a playable game with variables, event rules (when click / key /
button / timer / touch / start ... and a condition, run actions), on-screen UI, a playable character (side-scroller,
top-down or flight), health, damage zones, weapons, AI brains (state machines with vision and hearing), game HUD,
feedback presets, tweens, object pools, spawners, loot, interactables and saves.
Workflow: get_guide (read it first) -> build the scene with build/actors tools -> set_data on clickable nodes ->
define_vars -> define_rules -> define_ui -> set_input_mode or spawn_player -> start -> test with fire_event / step and
read get_state (vars, event log, errors) -> fix rules until a full game works -> export to keep it.
Definitions are undoable (history.undo) and stored as the JSON passed to the define_* tools (what export returns).

tools.description:
Defines an AI brain: a state machine whose states set movement, facing, firing and an icon, with transitions by expressions (sees, heard, distance, time_in_state, since_seen, at_goal, at_home, has_last_known, health, health_pct, player_alive, self and all variables). Assign it with assign_brain. Undoable.
Returns: The brain name. Fails if a state, move mode or transition target is invalid.

backend.description: Native: built-in steering and vision cone (no navmesh needed). Ai: a real AI agent - walks the navmesh around obstacles (call ai.build_navigation first) and senses with AI perception (sight, hearing of gunshots and ai.report_noise). Ground brains only.

speed.description: Cruise speed in cm/s (a state's speed overrides it).

tools.description:
Adds or replaces on-screen UI by name. Undoable. Use layout items: a widget tree like HTML + flexbox, laid out and aligned for you. A top-level item is {name, kind: panel|column|row|grid|stack, anchor: top-left|top|top-right|left| center|right|bottom-left|bottom|bottom-right, offset:[x,y], children:[...]}. Kinds: panel (card with the theme's background, border, radius and padding), column, row, grid (columns, cell:[w,h]), stack (layers), text (text, size: px or xs|sm|md|lg|xl|2xl|3xl, weight: light|regular|medium|bold|black, color, align: left|center|right, wrap, shadow), button (name, text or children, variant: primary|secondary|ghost|danger|success, disabled_if; hover and press are automatic), bar (value, max, fill, ghost, text), spacer, divider. Any node: gap, align (cross axis: start|center|end| stretch), justify (start|center|end|between), grow, width, height, min_width, max_width, min_height, max_height, padding and margin (n, [vertical, horizontal] or [top, right, bottom, left]), background, border_color, border_width, radius, opacity, rotate (degrees), visible_if, tooltip (template), h_align / v_align (place inside the parent), style_if:[{if, background, border_color, color, opacity}] (first match wins), repeat: n or "expr" with as: "i" (copies the node with a local index; a repeated button's rule reads event.i). Colors: theme tokens text, muted, subtle, accent, accent_text, panel, surface, surface_hover, border, overlay, success, warning, danger, info, gold, white, black, transparent ("panel/60" = 60% opacity), "#rrggbb[aa]", [r,g,b,a], or a live template like "{db[id].hex}". Text is a live template ("Gold {gold}"); buttons fire {"on":"button","filter":"<name>"} rules. Older flat items {name, kind: text|button|bar, anchor:[x,y] 0-1, size, font_size, color, background} still work.
Returns: Number of items and whether they are drawn on a viewport. Fails on the first invalid item, naming its path and the allowed fields (nothing changes).

theme.description: Theme patch, merged over the current one: {colors:{token:"#rrggbb"} (override or add tokens), radius, padding, gap, screen_margin, font_size, text_shadow}. (Any JSON value)

lock.description: Node the homing secondary weapon is locked on (empty if none).

mode.description: side, topdown or flight (empty without a player).

time.description: Game time in seconds since start.

vars.description: Variable name -> current value. (Any JSON value)

returnValue.title: LogicGameState

tools.description:
Advances game time in 0.1 s steps: timers, tick rules, movement, physics of the player, AI, projectiles (testing).
Returns: The running state with the last 10 log entries. Fails if the game is not running.
tools.name: logic.step

returnValue.description: The running state with the last 10 log entries. Fails if the game is not running.

ammo.description: Weapon owner -> rounds left in the magazine.

hidden.description: Node ids hidden by rules (shown again on restart).

interact.description: Interactable the player can use now (empty if none).

log.description: Recent events, oldest first: {seq, time, on, name, target, rules:[...], errors:[...]} ("errors" only when something failed).

play_objects.description: Objects created by rules during play (removed on restart).

controlled.description: Whether the local player controller possesses the character.

controls.description: How to play, for telling the user.

exists.description: Whether the character is in the world (false before {"player":"spawn"} with auto_spawn false, or without a player).

lock.description: Node the homing secondary weapon is locked on (empty if none).

mode.description: side, topdown or flight (empty without a player).

time.description: Game time in seconds since start.

vars.description: Variable name -> current value. (Any JSON value)

returnValue.title: LogicGameState

tools.description: Stops running rules, timers and movement. Definitions are kept; start runs the game again.
tools.name: logic.stop

tools.description:
Animates nodes smoothly: move / rotate / scale / color with easing, delay, yoyo or loop, and hide / show / release at the end. Works whether or not the game runs; the {"tween": ...} action does the same from rules.
Returns: Nodes started and tweens running. Fails if no property to animate is given or a target matches no node.

add.description: Run alongside other tweens on the node instead of replacing them.

color.description: End base color (builder materials). ([r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], linear 0-1)

emit.description: Custom event fired at the end (rules on "event").

loop.description: once, yoyo (there and back), loop (restart) or pingpong (forever).

repeat.description: Cycles for yoyo / loop (-1 = forever for loop).

scale.description: End scale: a number or [x,y,z]. (Any JSON value)

then.description: At the end: none, hide, show or release (back to its pool).

tools.name: logic.tween

returnValue.description: Nodes started and tweens running. Fails if no property to animate is given or a target matches no node.
returnValue.title: LogicTweenResult

tools.description:
Watches for contacts between any objects: when something in a starts overlapping something in b, rules with {"on":"contact","filter":"<name>"} run (target = the a object; event.data.self, event.data.other, event.data.from_above). Use it for anything touching anything: barrels hitting the hero, a ball entering a goal, a crate landing on a button. "player" works in a or b. Undoable.
Returns: Number of watches. Fails if a or b is empty or name is empty.

margin.description: Extra cm around the a objects (touch a little before overlapping).

name.description: Watch name, used as the rule filter, e.g. "barrel_hits_hero".

tools.name: logic.watch_contacts

returnValue.description: Number of watches. Fails if a or b is empty or name is empty.
